description: A tracked person's wellbeing state flipped (stage 10 item 2). `mean` is the posterior mean of the low-side rate against their own baseline and `evidence` the fresh turns' worth it rests on. Published only for an adult who said yes (contracts.people.may_check_in), only on a change, and never with their words. Initiative decides whether a check-in is worth it.
title: world.wellbeing.changed
